name: Peatling
ability: Smoky Cask / Flame Body / White Smoke (hidden)
look: a compact block of layered bog turf with a mossy top, glowing charcoal cracks and smoky breath
entry: Dug up from ancient coastal bogs, Peatling burns slowly for centuries, infusing nearby water springs with its distinct smoky flavor.
how: Wild: common in the Liquor Meadows (an overworld biome added by CobbleEffort: Kanto 0.8.0).
Its ability Smoky Cask powers up its Fire and Poison moves and fills the field with smoke that stops stats being lowered.
